## Tables S52–S53. Cooperation GAP on the behavioral rank gap

Each table estimates how the Cooperation GAP changes with the sender's Behavioral Social Rank minus the receiver's. Column (1) has no fixed effects, column (2) adds classroom fixed effects, and column (3) adds sender fixed effects. Standard errors are in parentheses.

```{r s9-regressions}
```

### Table S52. Observed tokens

These models use the Cooperation GAP calculated from all observed transfers in each sample.

### Table S53. Filtered tokens

These models use the Cooperation GAP for pairs in which both transfers survive the null-model filter.

## Table S54. Asymmetric friendships

These models use filtered tokens for one-sided friendship nominations. Direction is defined by the nominator's Behavioral Social Rank relative to the recipient's. The higher-to-lower group includes equal ranks, following the rule used in the code.

```{r s9-asymmetric}
```
